links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT-generated IR procedure pamphlets reviewed by two radiologists
links.effect: Shortcomings in 30% (30/100) of pamphlets, with 34 specific inaccuracies, including missing sedation information (10/34) and inaccurate procedural complication details (8/34).
links.quote: In a thorough analysis of the education pamphlets, we identified shortcomings in 30% (30/100) of pamphlets, with a total of 34 specific inaccuracies, including missing information about sedation for the procedure (10/34), inaccuracies related to specific procedural-related complications (8/34).

links.outcome: Consistency of pamphlets across repeated identical requests by different users
links.effect: Line-by-line comparison across users and procedures showed statistically significant inconsistencies (P < 0.001), despite consistent themes within groups.
links.quote: A key-word co-occurrence network showed consistent themes within each group of pamphlets, while a line-by-line comparison at the level of users and across different procedures showed statistically significant inconsistencies (P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of ChatGPT-generated patient pamphlets for interventional radiology procedures across multiple users and prompts, without evaluating a specific guardrail or deployment practice intervention.
